name: Dev Tools
description: A lightweight dev toolset under 200KB — instant to use. Sandboxed and offline with zero network access. High-frequency tools for crypto, encoding, text, data conversion, formatting, time, networking and image generation; inputs and options are remembered and sync seamlessly across devices via DBX.
releaseNotes: 修复：部分机器首页工具网格只显示 2 列且右侧留白（布局回归问题）；页脚 GitHub 入口点击后没有复制提示——浮层在空间不足时改为显示在控件上方，沙箱内复制失败时直接展示链接。视觉：收藏星标与收藏空状态图标改用主题色。 | Fix: on some machines the home grid shrank to 2 columns with dead space on the right (layout regression); the footer GitHub link gave no copy feedback — the chip now flips above the control when space is tight and shows the URL itself when copying is unavailable in the sandbox. Visual: favorite stars and the favorites empty-state now use the theme color.

zh-CN.name: Dev 工具集
zh-CN.description: 不到 200KB 的轻量开发者工具集，即开即用。沙箱离线运行，零网络权限。涵盖加解密、编解码、文本处理、数据转换、格式化、时间计算、网络运维、图像生成等众多高频工具；参数自动记忆，配置可随 DBX 跨端无缝同步。
